clips.title: The story
paras: Egalin's Grimoire is a prized arcane tome detailing the foundational rites required to summon and command a voidwalker. Penned by a master warlock, it serves as an essential teaching text within the Undercity's Temple of the Damned.

Written by the master summoner Egalin, this grimoire details the delicate and dangerous process of pulling a being of chaos from the Nether. Egalin was renowned among practitioners for his effortless command over summoned voidwalkers, an ability passed down to his students, including Carendin Halgar. Without the specific formulas and channeling methods recorded in the text, an unprepared summoner risks being torn apart by the very entity they call forth.
